title: The *Trillion* Frame
dek: Anthropic prices its IPO above range. Nvidia posts $115.8B without its founder. The governance frameworks were built for a different scale.

stories.label: oversubscribed as Anthropic prices its IPO above $78 initial range
stories.headline: Public markets now have a vote on what safety-first AI is worth.

stories.label: Corma raises for AI cyber defense at a $1B valuation
stories.headline: AI security is now a venture funding category of its own.

stories.label: in Q3 FY2027 revenue, up 103%, first report without Jensen Huang
stories.headline: Record quarter, falling stock: the narrative was priced in too.

stories.label: new MAI models launched at Ignite, plus MDASH agentic code security
stories.headline: Microsoft built an AI agent to watch the AI agents it just shipped.

stories.label: pledged for Trusted AI Accelerator across 48 Indo-Pacific nations
stories.headline: The governance frame and the operational frame are at different orders of magnitude.

stories.short: Court uses AI detector to sanction
stories.headline: The court used an AI detector to sanction lawyers for using AI, standard undefined.
The 7x oversubscription meets the secondary market.
Partner session track closes out the week's enterprise announcements.

still_signal: The governance frame was built for regulation speed. The $115B Nvidia quarter, $1.4T Anthropic IPO, and 7 models Microsoft shipped to watch the ones it shipped describe a different world.
